runs.text: Israel fits into Russia seven hundred and seventy five times. Here's Israel at true size: twenty two thousand and seventy two square kilometres. Judea and Samaria, also called the West Bank, and Gaza are shaded, not counted. First stop: Wales. Surprise: Wales is smaller. Israel doesn't quite fit. The whole UK? eleven Israels. Germany, sixteen. Now Russia. Watch the counter. seven hundred and seventy five Israels, from the Baltic Sea all the way to the Pacific. No map trick: every copy is true size, even in the Arctic. Size isn't everything. Russia has seven hundred and seventy five times the land, not seven hundred and seventy five times the people. Which European country should I drop Israel on next? Count Russia again.
